verdict.rationale: Kino AI is an agent-driven video editor with an MCP server, so shipping portable agent skills is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence describes skills as plain markdown files or folders, or any skill format at all. The 100+ templates are video design assets (titles, maps, captions, transitions), not agent skills, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format
